$Comment:
Luck-weighted Essence of the Void, beside the jar's own Disenchant_Void (whose chances rise with the piece's level and ignore luck). Named by Extensions/DisenchantingProgression.json and rolled once per ritual at the Payout beat, at both tables. The roll is a FIND: no Expected leaf, so it lands as a gold row, and it names the cue the jar's Disenchant action dresses. Its sibling Mmo_Disenchant_Voidheart holds the Voidheart: one table per find, so a station stat can roll this one again on its own (Mmo_Disenchant_Talents re-rolls it for Void Sight and the conditional piece bonuses).

The piece's level gates the roll and luck makes it likelier, never larger: a find is a yes or a no, so luck acts on the Chance and the grant stays one item. Luck here is whole points of Enchanting luck plus the global channel, a twentieth of a percent per point.

THE GUARDRAIL, checked at mithril, the gear whose recipes hold Void essence. Mithril gloves take 20 Void essence and salvage for 5. With every void roll at both tables firing on the same ritual (the jar's 1 to 2, the greater table's 1 and this file's 1, twice when a talent rolls it again) a pair still comes back with at most 10, and on average at full luck about 6, so unmaking never mints Void essence; the chest (80 in, 20 back) is further off still. The two Seeker techniques that roll the Void finds again (Void Rite on every ritual from its item level, Treasure Hunter on half of them, both in Mmo_Disenchant_Seekers) keep a pair well under what it cost on average even held together, about 4 a pair, since Treasure Hunter also halves the salvage return.

KIT RITE. An Enchanting talent read off the talent's own record (ziggfreedcommon:track_pick) trades the Void finds away for a second roll of the kit: this table's Requires, whose Not shuts it for that talent's holder alone, so everyone else, and a server with Enchanting switched off or no Enchanting track at all, rolls it as always. Every roll that rolls this table again follows the same gate.

Every chance and gate is balance data; retune by shipping a same-id file from a pack loading after this one.

Rolls.$Comment: Void essence: gear of item level 30 and up, 1 percent plus a twentieth per luck point, held under 6 percent.
